author: GameSpot
description:
In BLACKWOOD, you role-play as Anton, who is more than just an assassin. He runs a small DVD store, goes about his day, and keeps life looking completely ordinary. 

The morning starts with his routine, waking up, getting dressed, and running the shop. Then the pace shifts as he heads to the basement to gear up, grab ammo, train, and step into his assassination missions.

We can't wait for you to experience both sides of his life, from running the shop to taking on high-stakes missions.
